tex_content.label: corI.9.3
tex_content.html:
If the flow is defined on $[0,T]$ and $u$ tends to a delta function at $T$, then $v\le 0$ for $t<T$.
Proof

\sketch For positive $\square $-harmonic $h$, $d\int hv,dV/dt=-\int h\square ^*v,dV\ge 0$; the terminal flat-space limit is zero, so positivity of $h$ implies $v\le 0$.

□
Corollary
[convergence for Harnack inequalities]
